findings: The generic-ring Berkowitz implementation computes characteristic polynomials through ring sums/products and small determinant bases, without requiring inversion of Newton indices2or4.
In characteristic2, Newton traces cannot recover e2/e4 by dividing by their indices. A trace-only nilpotency shortcut therefore needs explicit counterexamples and full coefficient checks.
Berkowitz, Newton identities, trace/Frobenius arithmetic and Bernstein bounds are classical; no novelty certification follows from implementing these components.
scope: Primary implementation source review, not exhaustive literature novelty review or a performance measurement.
